item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: shane
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://ptenergy.com.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

item.content:encoded:
[vc_row bg_type="image" parallax_style="vcpb-default" bg_image_new="id^910|url^https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/trs-services-banner.jpg|caption^null|alt^null|title^trs-services-banner|description^null" bg_image_repeat="no-repeat" bg_override="ex-full" el_class="background-image-greyscale banner-make-image-black-and-white"][vc_column][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle"][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][vc_custom_heading text="Tubular Running Services" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left|color:%23FFFFFF" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779696544278{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="page-header-h1-outline"][vc_empty_space height="16px"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white page-subheader-text"]Field-proven crews. Engineered tools. Disciplined casing operations across new wells, completions, and workovers.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" equal_height="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784064120297{margin-top: -36px !important;}" el_class="stretched-row"][vc_column width="2/3" el_class="stretched-row-left"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_custom_heading text="The foundation of ProTorque Total Rig Solutions™" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779432540960{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]Tubular running services are the foundation of ProTorque. Casing programs, power tong operations, CRT execution, thread inspection, vacuum drifting. Every part of running pipe in the hole, delivered with the discipline operators rely on when the program has to go right the first time. ProTorque crews work across new well construction in Canada, completions and workover operations in the United States, and specialty applications including carbon capture wells and fiber-optic instrumented casing. The work is technical. The standard is the same on every job. Twenty-plus years of casing experience. Crews trained on every major connection. Our services
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Casing operations that show up ready." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779559609405{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]Running casing is the most consequential part of every drilling and completions program. Every joint matters, every connection matters, and every minute on the floor counts. ProTorque casing crews show up with the experience, the equipment, and the discipline to keep operations on schedule and connections inside spec. Whether the work is a new well in Alberta, a workover in West Texas, or a chrome casing program for CCS, the standard is the same. Skilled crews, calibrated power tongs, documented make-up, and the readiness to handle whatever the program asks for.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" el_class="pt-tcrw-media"][dt_fancy_image image_id="1532" width="" caption="off" extra_class="img-greyscale"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784183580051{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]

height="48px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784184046297{margin-bottom: -24px !important;padding-top: 36px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]
How we work
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Our process" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784184033094{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="10"][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

1

Pre-Job Planning

Connection specs, tally confirmation, equipment readiness, and crew composition locked in before the job starts. Power tongs are pre-calibrated against the connection requirements.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

2

On-Site Execution

Crew arrives prepared. Casing is run with attention to handling, alignment, and torque integrity. Every connection is monitored in real time with documented torque-turn graphs. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

3

Docs & Handoff

The job leaves with a complete record. Tally confirmation, make-up logs, connection-by-connection torque data, and any anomaly notes. Operators have what they need for audits and integrity tracking.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

4

Post-Job Review

Equipment returns to the shop for inspection and redress. Crew debriefs the job. Lessons feed into the next program.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" equal_height="yes" content_placement="middle" bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" css=".vc_custom_1784186145197{border-bottom-width: 2px !important;border-bottom-style: solid !important;border-color: #DADADA !important;}" el_class="stretched-row" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF"][vc_column width="7/12" el_class="stretched-row-left"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_custom_heading text="Why this matters" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784184560598{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1779560107404{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}"]Every casing program is a foundation for the well’s life cycle. A missed connection, a rushed run, or a calibration drift can turn into a costly remedial job or worse. ProTorque crews work the way the program was meant to be run: deliberately, with verification, and with documentation that holds up after the cement sets. For operators in Canada running new wells, this means a casing crew that integrates cleanly with the drilling program. For operators in the US running completions and workovers, this means fast-response crews that can mobilize for short-cycle work without compromising on quality. For specialty applications including CCS and fiber-optic instrumented casing, this means the same discipline applied to demanding pipe metallurgies and tighter connection tolerances.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_empty_space height="72px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" el_class="gradient-row-red" css=".vc_custom_1784060909726{padding-right: 110px !important;padding-left: 110px !important;}"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]

"

 

Documented connections. Calibrated equipment. Ready crews. Every casing program built on the same standard of execution.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF" el_class="cards-row-grey"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_custom_heading text="Connected services" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784186809848{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][vc_column_text css=""]Casing running connects to every other part of the TRS program. CRT Redress and Maintenance Program

item.title: Drilling Services
item.dc:creator: s3admin1
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row bg_type="image" parallax_style="vcpb-default" bg_image_new="id^186|url^https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/protorque-team-1.jpg|caption^null|alt^null|title^protorque-team-1|description^null" bg_image_repeat="no-repeat" bg_override="ex-full" el_class="background-image-greyscale banner-make-image-black-and-white"][vc_column][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle"][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][vc_custom_heading text="Drilling Services" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left|color:%23FFFFFF" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779773156627{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="page-header-h1-outline"][vc_empty_space height="16px"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white page-subheader-text"]Independent verification and monitoring that gives operators the numbers they can act on.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" equal_height="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784064120297{margin-top: -36px !important;}" el_class="stretched-row"][vc_column width="2/3" el_class="stretched-row-left"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_custom_heading text="The numbers you can trust." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779773296843{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]Drilling does not get more efficient by accident. It gets more efficient when the equipment that does the work has been calibrated, monitored, and verified by an independent third party. ProTorque drilling services do exactly that. From power tong torque to top drive performance, from hook load accuracy to iron roughneck calibration, ProTorque provides the independent verification operators need to drill faster, drill safer, and drill with confidence. Every service is built on the same principle: give the operator the data. Document the work. Catch the drift before it becomes a problem. No matter where the rig is, ProTorque crews show up with calibrated equipment, documented procedures, and real-time data systems that turn drilling decisions into informed ones.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_empty_space height="24px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3" el_class="gradient-row-red" css=".vc_custom_1784060909726{padding-right: 110px !important;padding-left: 110px !important;}"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]

All

major rig equipment covered[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white red-column-separator-above red-column-separator-below"]

Real-time

data capture and reporting[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]

Documented

every connection, every joint[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F5F5F5"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_custom_heading text="What we verify and monitor" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784584445841{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][vc_column_text css=""]Power tongs, top drive, iron roughneck, hook load, real-time data, and emerging applications. Every service is built around one outcome: numbers operators can act on.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784071977423{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

1

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784582770918{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

CATM for Power Tongs

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784582784253{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Independent torque verification at the connection. Calibrated automated torque make-up for power tong operations. Documented connection-by-connection data that operators can verify and trust.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784581287466{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore CATM for Power Tongs[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784072587472{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

2

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784582968035{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

CATM for Top Drive

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784582801089{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Calibrated make-up for every connection. Independent torque verification on top drive make-up operations. Catches calibration drift and confirms connection integrity before the program goes off plan.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784581338188{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="small-text"]Explore CATM for Top Drive[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784072596189{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

3

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583195094{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Top Drive + Hook Load Verification

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784582850272{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Trust the readings. Trust the equipment. Independent verification of top drive torque and hook load systems. Documented results give operators the numbers they need for performance benchmarking and audits.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784581398328{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="small-text"]Explore Hook Load Verification[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784072606542{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

4

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784582994653{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Torque Verification

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784582873525{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Catch the drift before it costs you time. Independent torque verification across rig equipment. The drift you do not catch becomes the NPT you cannot explain. ProTorque catches it.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784581482083{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore Torque Verification[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784072616051{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

5

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583005620{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Iron Roughneck Torque Testing

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784582895453{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Verify the iron roughneck. Verify the connection. Independent calibration and torque testing for iron roughneck systems. Confirms the equipment is making up connections the way the program calls for.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784581536948{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore Iron Roughneck Torque Testing[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784072623640{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

6

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583025493{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Real-Time Drilling Data

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784582914287{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Drilling data that supports the decision. Real-time drilling data systems and integration that put the operator in control of the rig. Pressure, torque, hook load, and connection data captured and delivered when it matters[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784581597197{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore Real-Time Drilling Data[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="How drilling verification works" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779774130630{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""][pt_tabs slug="drilling-services-page"][/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="What drilling verification supports" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779774386008{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][vc_column_text css=""]Drilling verification does not stand alone. It supports the casing program, the equipment that runs the work, and the broader field operation that follows.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""][pt_slider id="1491"][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row gap="25" equal_height="yes" bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#000000"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" content_placement="middle" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="4/12"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]

Need verification on your next program?

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="4/12"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]Talk to ProTorque about CATM, hook load verification, torque testing, or any of our drilling verification services.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="4/12"][ult_buttons btn_title="Get in Touch" btn_link="url:%2Fcontact-us%2F" btn_align="ubtn-right" btn_size="ubtn-custom" btn_width="225" btn_title_color="#FFFFFF" btn_bg_color="#D5292E" btn_hover="ubtn-fade-bg" btn_bg_color_hover="#FFFFFF" btn_title_color_hover="#D5292E" icon_size="32" btn_icon_pos="ubtn-sep-icon-at-right" btn_border_style="solid" btn_color_border="#00000000" btn_color_border_hover="#00000000" btn_border_size="0" btn_radius="0" el_class="button-standard button-cta-row button-cta-row-left" btn_font_size="desktop:14px;" btn_line_height="desktop:14px;"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="36px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

item.dc:creator: s3admin1
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row bg_type="image" parallax_style="vcpb-default" bg_image_new="id^1476|url^https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/IMG_7919.jpeg|caption^null|alt^null|title^IMG_7919|description^null" bg_image_repeat="no-repeat" bg_override="ex-full" el_class="background-image-greyscale banner-make-image-black-and-white"][vc_column][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle"][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][vc_custom_heading text="Midstream Services" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left|color:%23FFFFFF" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779776011342{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="page-header-h1-outline"][vc_empty_space height="16px"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white page-subheader-text"]Construction, maintenance, and operational support for the facilities and pipelines that move energy.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" equal_height="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784064120297{margin-top: -36px !important;}" el_class="stretched-row"][vc_column width="2/3" el_class="stretched-row-left"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_custom_heading text="The crews behind reliable midstream operations." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779776341224{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]Facility reliability does not happen by accident. It takes skilled trades, fast response, and crews that understand the infrastructure they are working on. ProTorque provides midstream services for operators across North America: construction, maintenance, electrical and instrumentation, mechanical, environmental, ROW, and specialty piping. The work that keeps facilities operational and infrastructure performing. Whether the program is a new facility build in the Permian Basin, a turnaround in West Texas, a pipeline tie-in, or ongoing E&I and mechanical support for a midstream operator, ProTorque shows up with the trades, the equipment, and the discipline to keep operations on schedule. Twenty-plus years of energy services experience. Combo welders for poly, carbon, and stainless. Master electricians on staff. Both mechanical and electrical departments under one roof for turnkey operations and builds.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_empty_space height="24px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3" el_class="gradient-row-red" css=".vc_custom_1784060909726{padding-right: 110px !important;padding-left: 110px !important;}"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]

Full-trade

Capability under one roof[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white red-column-separator-above red-column-separator-below"]

Permian

And beyond[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]

T&M

Turnkey work[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F5F5F5"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_custom_heading text="What we deliver on the midstream side" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779776470669{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][vc_column_text css=""]Six capability areas, all the trades and disciplines a midstream operator needs from a single services contractor. Build, maintain, expand, or support. ProTorque covers it.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784071977423{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

1

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583816125{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Midstream Construction

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583658066{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]New facilities, pipelines, and infrastructure built right. Plant construction, pipeline construction, facility expansion, civil work, foundations, and turnkey midstream builds. Combo welders for poly, carbon, and stainless.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784577189964{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore Midstream Construction[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784072587472{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

2

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583828130{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Plant and Pipeline Maintenance

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583679511{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Keeping facilities running. Responding fast when they need support. Ongoing maintenance, plant turnarounds, T&M work, pipeline maintenance, and reliability programs. The crews operators call when downtime is not an option.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784577440077{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="small-text"]Explore Plant and Pipeline Maintenance[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784072596189{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

3

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583840952{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Facilities Electrical I&C and Mechanical

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583708022{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Master electricians and mechanical trades under one roof. Electrical and instrumentation, mechanical trades, and full E&I-Mech capability for facility builds, expansions, and ongoing maintenance. Turnkey when operators need it.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784577536776{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="small-text"]Explore Facilities E&I and Mechanical [/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784072606542{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

4

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583857260{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Environmental and Water Management

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583729929{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Water, environmental, and compliance services for midstream operations. Produced water management, clean brine facility operations, environmental compliance, and integrated water management programs. Connected to ProTorque’s broader water and drilling capability.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784577624908{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore Environmental and Water Management [/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784072616051{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

5

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583875027{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

ROW Services

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583750892{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Right of way clearing, pads, and civil work that gets the project ready. ROW clearing, new pad construction, civil concrete work, industrial weed control, and the foundational site work that midstream construction depends on.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784577685404{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore ROW Services [/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784072623640{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

6

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1786234623293{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Specialty Piping

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784583768001{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Fiber glass piping and specialty material installation. Fiber glass piping installation for facilities and corrosive-service applications. Combo-welded carbon and stainless piping for facility expansions and new builds.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784577743020{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" !important;}"]ProTorque midstream services support operators across the Permian Basin and broader oil and gas country. Coordination with operators, EPCs, and downstream service providers keeps midstream programs moving from plan to delivery.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1779777030245{margin-top: 24px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;}"]

item.dc:creator: s3admin1
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row bg_type="image" parallax_style="vcpb-default" bg_image_new="id^910|url^https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/trs-services-banner.jpg|caption^null|alt^null|title^trs-services-banner|description^null" bg_image_repeat="no-repeat" bg_override="ex-full" el_class="background-image-greyscale banner-make-image-black-and-white"][vc_column][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle"][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][vc_custom_heading text="Equipment & Innovation" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left|color:%23FFFFFF" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779794853131{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="page-header-h1-outline"][vc_empty_space height="16px"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white page-subheader-text"]Purpose-built equipment for tubular running, drilling, and casing operations. Engineered, field-proven equipment.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" equal_height="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784064120297{margin-top: -36px !important;}" el_class="stretched-row"][vc_column width="2/3" el_class="stretched-row-left"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_custom_heading text="Equipment designed by the crews that use it." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779786029416{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]Every piece of equipment in the ProTorque lineup exists because crews in the field needed a better answer to a real problem. Dropped object risks on the rig floor. RCD installs creating handling exposure. BHA assembly chewing up the critical path. Make-up that needed to happen somewhere other than the rig floor. ProTorque engineers and supplies the lineup, field-proves it on rigs across Canada, the USA, and South America. The result is engineered equipment that solves operational problems because it was built to solve operational problems.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_empty_space height="24px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3" el_class="gradient-row-red" css=".vc_custom_1784060909726{padding-right: 110px !important;padding-left: 110px !important;}"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white hide-on-all-temp"]

20+

Years Operating[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white red-column-separator-above red-column-separator-below hide-on-all-temp"]

3

Countries Active[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white hide-on-all-temp"]

All

Major Connections[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F5F5F5"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_custom_heading text="The ProTorque equipment lineup" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784586265883{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784071977423{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

1

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587458604{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

CRT Tether Ring

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1786260631079{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Dropped object prevention for CRT operations. Engineered safety equipment that prevents the CRT from becoming a dropped object risk during casing operations. Inspection, maintenance, and field readiness backed by ProTorque.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784588258148{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore CRT Tether Ring[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784072587472{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

2

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587475672{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Mobile BHA Frame

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587716193{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Offline BHA assembly. Safer starts. Move bottom hole assembly work off the rig floor and into a controlled, horizontal setup. Saves time, reduces exposure, supports cleaner starts.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784588273264{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="small-text"]Explore Mobile BHA Frame[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784072596189{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

3

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587487832{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Mobile Bucking Frame

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587772430{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Portable make-up off the rig floor. Controlled make-up for accessories, shop work, and remote operations. Moves the work to where the operator needs it, not where the rig dictates.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784588291370{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="small-text"]Explore Mobile Bucking Frame [/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784586885222{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

4

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587497140{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

RCD Press

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587818896{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]RCD installs, taken offline. Take RCD installation off the rig floor. Reduce handling exposure. Reduce MPD NPT. Clear ROI that operations and procurement can justify on the AFE.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784588308203{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="small-text"]Explore RCD Press [/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784586891990{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

5

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587519019{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Electric Hydraulic Power Unit (eHPU)

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587894277{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Hydraulic power without the diesel. Electric hydraulic power for tubular running and rig support operations. Cleaner, quieter, lower fuel consumption, lower maintenance burden.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784588327002{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore eHPU [/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784586896869{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

6

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587531264{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Vacuum Drift System

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587947316{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Verified casing ID before the run. Engineered vacuum drift equipment for documented casing ID confirmation. Faster, cleaner, more verifiable than conventional drift methods.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784588341208{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore Vacuum Drift System [/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784586900996{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

7

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587542861{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Break-Out Vise

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587995416{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Controlled break-out for tubular operations. Engineered break-out vise for tubular operations where controlled, documented break-out matters.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784588353869{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore Break-Out Vise [/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784586905466{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

8

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587554509{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

CRT Nubbin

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784588042782{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Supporting equipment for CRT operations. Engineered nubbin equipment supporting CRT operations alongside the Tether Ring and ProTorque’s casing running services.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784588366466{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore CRT Nubbin [/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784586921992{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

9

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587570295{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Pipe Roller

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784588092252{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Tubular handling. Done right. Engineered pipe handling equipment for tubular operations. Built to support casing yards, pipe handling, and pre-run staging.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784588382825{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore Pipe Roller [/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784586928738{margin-bottom: 32px !important;}"]

10

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784587582692{margin-bottom: 24px !important;}"]

Flush Mounted Spider

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784588146520{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Floor-level safety for casing operations. Flush-mounted spider equipment supplied by ProTorque. Cleaner rig floor, reduced trip hazards, safer casing handling. Available through ProTorque directly.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784588399679{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-small"]Explore Flush Mounted Spider [/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_empty_space el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Where the equipment goes to work" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779792327666{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][vc_column_text css=""]ProTorque equipment is used across the full service set. From casing operations to drilling verification, the equipment connects to real field work.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""][pt_slider id="1512"][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row gap="25" equal_height="yes" bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#000000"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" content_placement="middle" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="4/12"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]

item.title: About
item.dc:creator: s3admin1
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row bg_type="image" parallax_style="vcpb-default" bg_image_new="id^1109|url^https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/protorque-about.jpg|caption^null|alt^null|title^protorque-about|description^null" bg_image_repeat="no-repeat" bg_override="ex-full" el_class="background-image-greyscale"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][vc_custom_heading text="About ProTorque" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left|color:%23FFFFFF" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779941023204{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="page-header-h1-outline"][vc_empty_space height="16px"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white page-subheader-text"]Total Rig and Midstream Solutions. Engineering, crews, and discipline built across twenty-plus years.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" equal_height="yes" content_placement="middle" el_class="pt-two-column-red-white" css=".vc_custom_1784024729676{padding-top: 0px !important;padding-right: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;padding-left: 0px !important;}"][vc_column width="5/12" el_class="pt-tcrw-media"][dt_fancy_image image_id="45" width="" caption="off"][/vc_column][vc_column width="7/12" el_class="pt-tcrw-copy"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784532314469{margin-bottom: -24px !important;padding-top: 36px !important;}" el_class="text-red"]
Our story
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="The total rig and midstream solutions story" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784626891539{margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]Proudly serving the Oil & Gas Industry since 2004, ProTorque is an industry-leading Energy Services company providing integrated Tubular Running Services and Midstream Construction solutions to operators. Our dedicated international presence includes ProTorque Energy Canada Ltd., ProTorque Energy Inc. (USA), and ProTorque Energy SAS (serving select markets in South America). Our focus on innovation, safety, and operational excellence sets us apart as a trusted partner delivering unmatched value to our clients.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F5F5F5"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784627164863{margin-bottom: -24px !important;padding-top: 36px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]
Our foundation
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="The principles that guide us" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784626721975{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="10"][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

Adapting to an Evolving Industry

We understand the dynamic nature of the oil and gas landscape. ProTorque proactively embraces technological advancements, regulatory shifts, and the unique demands of each project. This forward-thinking approach is at the core of our growth from a regional tubular running services provider to a respected international solutions leader.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

Safety: Our Unwavering Commitment

At ProTorque, safety is a guiding principle. Our exceptional safety record is a testament to our rigorous training programs, emphasis on open communication, and the empowerment of every employee to prioritize a hazard-free work environment. This commitment protects our people, our clients’ assets, and ensures seamless operations.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

In-House Innovation for Real-World Impact

ProTorque’s commitment to innovation extends beyond adopting industry advancements. We develop proprietary solutions in-house, designed to directly address the challenges our teams face on the ground. This practical approach has led to the creation of tools like the Mobile Bucking Frame, BHA Frame, and Tether Ring, enhancing safety, efficiency, and overall project success.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

Collaborative Partnerships for Success

We view ourselves as an extension of our clients’ teams. ProTorque invests in understanding your project objectives, tailoring our solutions for maximum impact. Our collaborative approach fosters a shared commitment to safety, efficiency, and ultimately, the success of your operations.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row content_placement="middle" bg_type="image" bg_override="ex-full" css=".vc_custom_1784224258921{background-image: url(https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/protorque-rig-1.jpg?id=1264) !important;}" el_class="centered-content-row"][vc_column css=".vc_custom_1784223310357{padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="centered-content-row"][vc_empty_space height="128px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle"][vc_column_inner width="1/6" offset="vc_hidden-xs"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="centered-content" width="2/3" css=".vc_custom_1784223125707{margin-top: 0px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;background-color: #000000 !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784626659655{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-red"]
Our commitment
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="The ProTorque advantage" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784624449278{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-white"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784628820315{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-white"]
  • Safety as a Core Value: An uncompromised dedication to protecting people and assets.[dt_gap height="10" /]
  • Industry-Leading Expertise: Delivering efficient and reliable solutions.[dt_gap height="10" /]
  • Technology-Driven Approach: Utilizing advancements to maximize results.[dt_gap height="10" /]
  • Partnership Mindset: Aligning our goals with yours for long-term success.[dt_gap height="10" /]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/6" offset="vc_hidden-xs"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_empty_space height="164px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F5F5F5"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784626747906{margin-bottom: -24px !important;padding-top: 36px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]
How we do it
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="The methodology behind the work" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784626706830{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="10"][vc_column_inner width="1/5"][vc_column_text css=""]

1

Identify

Our sales team schedules a client meeting to identify the project requirements.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/5"][vc_column_text css=""]

2

Collaborate

The project requirements are presented to the management team. Management establishes the personnel and equipment requirements for successful job completion.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/5"][vc_column_text css=""]

3

Propose

The requirement details are presented to our client. Our goal is always to complete the job as efficiently as possible.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/5"][vc_column_text css=""]

4

Execute

Equipment and personnel are mobilized to the job site to complete the outlined project requirements in a timely and professional manner.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/5"][vc_column_text css=""]

5

Report

KPIs and metrics are collected, reviewed and outlined for future improvement.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" bg_type="image" bg_override="ex-full" css=".vc_custom_1784031758006{background-image: url(https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/protorque-and-prostar.jpg?id=1151) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_class="pt-irp"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="400px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="pt-irp-row"][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-irp-gap" width="1/2"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-irp-box" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="Our core values" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784585874170{margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]
Our core values are the fundamental beliefs of ProTorque as an organization. These guiding principles dictate our behavior when working with our Customers and help our people execute our services to the highest standards. It has helped our company to determine the correct path for growth while fulfilling our goals. These Core Values are used to coach our team and contribute towards the greater good of our industry.[dt_gap height="10" /]
  • Eliminate the Mediocre[dt_gap height="10" /]
  • Skilled Influential Confidence[dt_gap height="10" /]
  • Ownership Without Entitlement[dt_gap height="10" /]
  • Execute for the Greater Good
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784532123232{margin-bottom: -24px !important;padding-top: 36px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]
International presence
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Where ProTorque operates" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779941065612{margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]ProTorque operates across three continents, supporting operators with the same standards, the same equipment, and the same discipline regardless of region.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""][pt_map][/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F5F5F5" el_class="cards-row-grey"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784628006072{margin-bottom: -24px !important;padding-top: 36px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]
Our people
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Meet the team" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784627317560{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]ProTorque’s greatest asset is our people. We cultivate a team of skilled professionals with a deep understanding of TRS and Midstream operations and the industry’s complexities. This expertise translates into superior problem-solving, reduced errors, and the ability to optimize processes, delivering tangible benefits for our clients. Documented operations.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784181747107{margin-bottom: -24px !important;padding-top: 36px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow-caps"]
Why ProTorque
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="The foundation of ProTorque Total Rig and Midstream Solutions" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784633204902{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][ultimate_heading main_heading="Real Work" heading_tag="h4" alignment="left" main_heading_margin="margin-bottom:30px;"][/ultimate_heading][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784181409923{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}"]

ProTorque crews work the rigs and facilities that make energy work. Tubular running, drilling verification, midstream construction, equipment operations. Real field work for real operators.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][ultimate_heading main_heading="Documented Operations" heading_tag="h4" alignment="left" main_heading_margin="margin-bottom:30px;"][/ultimate_heading][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784181404131{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}"]

Every job runs through the same discipline: clean work, accurate measurement, complete records. Skilled trades doing the work the way the program calls for it.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][ultimate_heading main_heading="Career Path" heading_tag="h4" alignment="left" main_heading_margin="margin-bottom:30px;"][/ultimate_heading][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784181637502{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}"]

Field crews move into supervisory roles. Operators move into project leadership. Technical specialists grow into product and equipment teams. The path exists if you put in the work.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="25"][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_empty_space height="48px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" bg_type="image" bg_override="ex-full" css=".vc_custom_1784181039809{background-image: url(https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/protorque-rig-1.jpg?id=1264) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_class="pt-irp"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="400px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="pt-irp-row"][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-irp-gap" width="1/2"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-irp-box" width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784180196602{margin-bottom: -24px !important;padding-top: 36px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow text-white"]
Where we work
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Field, shop, and office" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784180206400{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-white"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]ProTorque careers happen across field operations, equipment shops, and project leadership offices. The field crews work on rigs and at midstream sites. The shops maintain CRTs, redress equipment, and prepare pipe. The offices coordinate project execution, manage equipment programs, and run the business that supports the field work. Most ProTorque careers start in the field. The people who run our programs today started by running pipe yesterday. That path is open to people who show up ready, work clean, and want to build a career instead of just clock hours[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF" el_id="current-opportunities"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1780006099377{margin-bottom: -24px !important;padding-top: 36px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]

Our method
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Drift testing engineered for the modern casing program." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784220999242{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="text-white"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784619093518{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-white"]Conventional drift methods work, but they leave room for inconsistency and miss dimensional issues that can show up downhole. The Vacuum Drift System changes the approach. The system verifies casing ID with documented evidence on every joint, faster than conventional drift methods and with cleaner workflow. Used by ProTorque on premium connection programs, chrome casing operations, and specialty applications including CCS and fiber-optic casing.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/6" offset="vc_hidden-xs"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_empty_space height="164px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" equal_height="yes" content_placement="middle" el_class="stretched-row"][vc_column width="7/12" el_class="stretched-row-left"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_custom_heading text="Specifications" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780428140139{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""][table id=3 /][/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_empty_space height="24px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1784227793714{padding-right: 72px !important;padding-left: 72px !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F5F5F5"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_custom_heading text="Why operators use it" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780398202458{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_empty_space height="36px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=""]

1

Faster joint verification

Vacuum drift verifies casing ID significantly faster than conventional methods. The system keeps casing programs on schedule.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="make-pretty"]

2

Documented results per joint

Every drift result captured and logged. The operator has documented evidence of casing ID compliance before the run.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=""]

3

Specialty casing compatibility

Works on chrome casing, premium connections, and specialty materials where conventional methods may not provide the same verification quality.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF" el_class="cards-row-grey"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="How ProTorque uses this equipment" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780397834134{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="30" css=".vc_custom_1784095240728{padding-right: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_inner el_class="cards-col-grey" width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1784093926050{padding-top: 0px !important;padding-right: 0px !important;padding-left: 0px !important;background-color: #3B4856 !important;}"][vc_single_image image="1564" img_size="full" alignment="center" css=".vc_custom_1784618245547{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" image_hovers="false" el_class="img-greyscale"][vc_empty_space height="36px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784617715519{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 24px !important;padding-right: 48px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;padding-left: 48px !important;}" el_class="text-white text-small"]

Vacuum Drifting & Casing ID Confirmation

Clear ROI on the AFE.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/12"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="6/12"][vc_single_image image="766" img_size="500x500" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false" el_class="product-photo"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="RCD installation, done offline." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780397626163{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]Rotating Control Devices (RCDs) are essential equipment for managed pressure drilling, but they are not easy to install. The press moves RCD installation offline, into a controlled environment where the work can happen without burning rig hours or putting crew at risk. NPT reduction on MPD operations

RCD installation moves off the critical path. The RCD is ready when the operation needs it. Conventional installation NPT is removed from the AFE.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="text-white" width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1780399226241{padding-top: 36px !important;padding-right: 36px !important;padding-left: 36px !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]

Crews install RCDs in a controlled environment with proper handling equipment, not on a rig floor under time pressure. Significant HSE improvement.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="text-white" width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1780399219272{padding-top: 36px !important;padding-right: 36px !important;padding-left: 36px !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]

Clear ROI for operations and procurement

The press pays for itself in saved rig hours on MPD programs. Operations leadership gets the safety case; procurement gets the cost justification.

item.title: Electric Hydraulic Power Unit
item.dc:creator: s3admin1
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F5F5F5"][vc_column][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes"][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-hero-btns" width="5/12"][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_custom_heading text="Electric Hydraulic Power Unit (eHPU)" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left|color:%23FFFFFF" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1786258023289{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="page-header-equipment"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="page-subheader-text"]Hydraulic power without the diesel. Cleaner, quieter, lower fuel burn, lower maintenance.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/12"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="6/12"][vc_single_image image="800" img_size="500x470" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false" el_class="product-photo"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="Hydraulic power, electrified." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780397626163{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]Conventional hydraulic power units run on diesel. They are loud, they burn fuel, they emit exhaust, and they need maintenance the operator did not plan for. The Electric Hydraulic Power Unit (eHPU) replaces the diesel with an electric drive that delivers the same hydraulic capacity with a cleaner, quieter footprint. Used by ProTorque on tubular running operations and supporting rig work where cleaner power matters.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="25"][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Why operators use it" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780398202458{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="15" el_class="pt-steps"][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1780399158241{padding-top: 36px !important;padding-right: 36px !important;padding-bottom: 36px !important;padding-left: 36px !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]

Lower fuel and emissions

No diesel burn means lower fuel cost, lower emissions, and a smaller environmental footprint at the rig site.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="text-white" width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1780399226241{padding-top: 36px !important;padding-right: 36px !important;padding-left: 36px !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]

Quieter operation

Electric drive cuts noise significantly. Better for crew comfort, better for HSE, better for sites with sound restrictions.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="text-white" width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1780399219272{padding-top: 36px !important;padding-right: 36px !important;padding-left: 36px !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]

Lower maintenance burden

Fewer moving parts than a diesel HPU. Lower routine maintenance. Lower long-term cost of operation.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="96px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="How ProTorque uses this equipment" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780397834134{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="25"][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1779434048501{border-top-width: 2px !important;border-right-width: 2px !important;border-bottom-width: 2px !important;border-left-width: 2px !important;padding-top: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;border-left-style: solid !important;border-right-style: solid !important;border-top-style: solid !important;border-bottom-style: solid !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_single_image image="1738" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1780397891236{margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;}"]
Casing Running and Power Tong Services
Tubular running operations powered by eHPU. Explore Casing Running[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1779433773659{border-top-width: 2px !important;border-right-width: 2px !important;border-bottom-width: 2px !important;border-left-width: 2px !important;padding-top: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;border-left-style: solid !important;border-right-style: solid !important;border-top-style: solid !important;border-bottom-style: solid !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_single_image image="1805" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false" el_class="img-greyscale"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1780397934418{margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;}"]
Mobile BHA Frame
Offline BHA assembly powered by eHPU.
