item.title: Break-Out Vise
item.dc:creator: s3admin1
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F5F5F5"][vc_column][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes"][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-hero-btns" width="5/12"][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_custom_heading text="Break-Out Vise" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left|color:%23FFFFFF" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1786258154058{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="page-header-equipment"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="page-subheader-text"]Controlled, documented break-out for tubular operations. Built for shops, yards, and remote work.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/12"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="6/12"][vc_single_image image="815" img_size="500x400" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false" el_class="product-photo"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="Break-out without the rig floor." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780397626163{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]Not every break-out happens on the rig floor. Shop work, accessory disassembly, remote yard operations all need controlled break-out capability that does not depend on rig availability. The Break-Out Vise provides that capability in a portable, engineered form. Used by ProTorque across shop operations and supporting work where controlled break-out matters.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="817" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="25"][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Specifications" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780428140139{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][vc_column_text css=""][table id=8 /][/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="25"][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="16px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Why operators use it" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780398202458{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="15" el_class="pt-steps"][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1780399158241{padding-top: 36px !important;padding-right: 36px !important;padding-bottom: 36px !important;padding-left: 36px !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]

Portable, ready capability

The vise goes where the work is. No dependency on rig floor schedules.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="text-white" width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1780399226241{padding-top: 36px !important;padding-right: 36px !important;padding-left: 36px !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]

Controlled break-out

Engineered holding force keeps break-out controlled and documented. Reduces handling risk on stuck or high-torque connections.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="text-white" width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1780399219272{padding-top: 36px !important;padding-right: 36px !important;padding-left: 36px !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]

Faster starts. Cleaner workflows. Reduced exposure.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/12"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="6/12"][vc_single_image image="789" img_size="500x400" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false" el_class="product-photo"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="BHA assembly that does not have to happen on the rig floor." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780397626163{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]Traditional BHA assembly happens on the rig floor, on the critical path, with crews working in tight spaces and tighter timelines. The Mobile BHA Frame changes that. The frame moves BHA assembly into a controlled, horizontal setup off the rig floor, where the work can happen ahead of time without burning rig hours. Used by ProTorque on drilling programs across North America.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_empty_space][vc_video link="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D7jWNjaKBso" !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]

Critical path savings

BHA assembly comes off the critical path. The rig is not waiting on the BHA. The BHA is ready when the rig is.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="text-white" width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1780399226241{padding-top: 36px !important;padding-right: 36px !important;padding-left: 36px !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]

Reduced HSE exposure

Crew works in a controlled environment instead of on the rig floor under time pressure. Lower exposure. Cleaner workflow.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="text-white" width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1780399219272{padding-top: 36px !important;padding-right: 36px !important;padding-left: 36px !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]

Documented BHA make-up

Connection make-up can be documented and verified during offline assembly. The BHA arrives at the rig with the records, not the rig floor scrambling to capture them.

item.content:encoded:
[vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F5F5F5"][vc_column][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes"][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-hero-btns" width="5/12"][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_custom_heading text="CRT Tether Ring" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left|color:%23FFFFFF" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1786257376350{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}" el_class="page-header-equipment"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="page-subheader-text"]Engineered dropped-object prevention for CRT operations. Safer rig floors. Documented protection.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/12"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="6/12"][vc_single_image image="755" img_size="500x500" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false" el_class="product-photo"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="CRT operations protected from dropped object risk." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780397626163{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]The CRT is one of the most consequential pieces of equipment on the rig floor during a casing run. It is also one of the more dangerous if anything goes wrong. The CRT Tether Ring is engineered safety equipment that prevents the CRT from becoming a dropped object during casing operations. Field-proven by ProTorque across casing operations in Canada, the USA, and South America.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="25"][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Specifications" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780428140139{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][vc_column_text css=""][table id=2 /][/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="25"][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="16px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Why operators use it" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780398202458{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="15" el_class="pt-steps"][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1780399158241{padding-top: 36px !important;padding-right: 36px !important;padding-bottom: 36px !important;padding-left: 36px !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]

Dropped object prevention

Engineered tether captures the CRT if a primary attachment fails. Operators get documented protection against one of the highest-consequence dropped object scenarios on the rig floor.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="text-white" width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1780399226241{padding-top: 36px !important;padding-right: 36px !important;padding-left: 36px !important;background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]

Inspection and recertification program

Our Tether Ring Recertification Program keeps the equipment inspected and certified to known standards. Operators get equipment with a paper trail and a service history.

Field-proven across operations

el_class="pt-steps"][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
1Intake and Inspection
Every CRT returning from a job is inspected for wear, damage, and operational status. Findings are logged and the redress plan is built.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
2Redress and Service
The tool is fully redressed: worn components replaced, seals renewed, hydraulics serviced, and assemblies rebuilt to factory specification.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
3Test and Certify
The redressed CRT runs through pressure and functional testing. Documentation is generated for audit traceability.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
4Ready Pool
Certified tools are returned to the ready pool. When the next job needs a CRT, the operator gets one with current paperwork and verified status.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Why this matters" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779521003852{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="20"][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1780910022126{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}"]A CRT that fails on the floor is a costly problem. Rig time stops, replacement tools have to be mobilized, and the casing run goes off plan. The redress and maintenance program is how ProTorque keeps that from happening. Every tool that leaves the shop has been inspected, serviced, and documented to a known standard. This matters for operator audits, for fleet reliability across multiple regions, and for the kind of operational consistency that lets ProTorque mobilize crews on short notice for completions, workovers, and specialty applications.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_message message_box_style="solid-icon" style="square" message_box_color="alert-info" icon_fontawesome="fa fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation" css=".vc_custom_1780910047192{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 48px !important;padding-right: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 48px !important;padding-left: 5em !important;background-color: #FFFFFF !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}" el_class="pull-quote info-highlight"]

“Every CRT that leaves the shop has a paper trail. Every tool on the floor has a record. Every record stands up to an audit.”

[/vc_message][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Connected services" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779520807388{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][vc_column_text css=""]The CRT is the centerpiece of every casing run. Casing Running and Power Tong Services
Where the CRT goes to work, supported by skilled crews and calibrated power tongs. Explore Casing Running[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1779433773659{border-top-width: 2px !important;border-right-width: 2px !important;border-bottom-width: 2px !important;border-left-width: 2px !important;padding-top: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;border-left-style: solid !important;border-right-style: solid !important;border-top-style: solid !important;border-bottom-style: solid !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_single_image image="1739" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1780986745746{margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;}"]
Tubular Thread Cleaning and Inspection
Confirms connection integrity before pipe reaches the rig floor. Explore Thread Cleaning[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1779434076387{border-top-width: 2px !important;border-right-width: 2px !important;border-bottom-width: 2px !important;border-left-width: 2px !important;padding-top: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;border-left-style: solid !important;border-right-style: solid !important;border-top-style: solid !important;border-bottom-style: solid !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_single_image image="1524" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false" el_class="img-greyscale"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1786232845360{margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;}"]
Engineered Equipment
CRT Tether Ring and CRT Nubbin engineered to support CRT operations on the rig floor. Explore Equipment [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#00000000" el_class="gradient-row-red"][vc_column][vc_empty_space height="72px"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/12"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="8/12"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white cta-row"]

Need a CRT for your next program?[dt_gap height="10" /]

ProTorque keeps a documented, ready CRT fleet for casing operations across Canada, the USA, and South America. Talk to us about your upcoming work.

Before a single joint of casing goes in the hole, ProTorque crews handle the preparation work that determines whether the run is a success or a callback. Clean threads. Gauged connections. Documented tally. When this work is done right, casing runs are predictable. When it is skipped or rushed, problems show up after the cement has set.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="list-icon-item" content_font_size="desktop:18px;" content_line_ht="desktop:22px;"]Visual inspection of every connection for damage, corrosion, and handling marks[/ultimate_icon_list_item][ultimate_icon_list_item icon_type="custom" icon_img="id^299|url^https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/checkmark-red.svg|caption^null|alt^null|title^checkmark-red|description^null" el_class="list-icon-item" el_class="list-icon-item" content_font_size="desktop:18px;" content_line_ht="desktop:22px;"]Gauge inspection where required to verify connections are within content_font_size="desktop:18px;" content_line_ht="desktop:22px;"]Laser tally confirmation so every joint is accounted for before it reaches the rig[/ultimate_icon_list_item][/ultimate_icon_list][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][ultimate_icon_list icon_size="36" icon_margin="16"][ultimate_icon_list_item icon_type="custom" icon_img="id^299|url^https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/checkmark-red.svg|caption^null|alt^null|title^checkmark-red|description^null" el_class="list-icon-item" content_font_size="desktop:18px;" content_line_ht="desktop:22px;"]Documentation that supports post-job reporting and QA records[/ultimate_icon_list_item][ultimate_icon_list_item icon_type="custom" icon_img="id^299|url^https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/checkmark-red.svg|caption^null|alt^null|title^checkmark-red|description^null" el_class="list-icon-item" content_font_size="desktop:18px;" content_line_ht="desktop:22px;"]Service for casing, tubing, drill pipe, and premium connections[/ultimate_icon_list_item][ultimate_icon_list_item icon_type="custom" content_font_size="desktop:18px;" content_line_ht="desktop:22px;"]On-site or pre-mobilization service depending on program requirements[/ultimate_icon_list_item][ultimate_icon_list_item css=".vc_custom_1779942579052{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="15" el_class="pt-steps"][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
1Receiving and Layout
Pipe is received, laid out, and prepared for inspection. Every joint is accounted for before the work starts.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
2Visual and Gauge Inspection
Each connection is inspected for damage, corrosion, and handling marks. Gauge inspection confirms the connection is within manufacturer spec.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
3Cleaning
Pin and box ends are cleaned to remove debris, mill scale, and old thread compound. Connections are prepared for proper make-up.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
4Laser Tally and Documentation
Every joint is logged, measured, and confirmed. The operator receives a complete tally and inspection report before the run begins.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Why this matters" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779521003852{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="20"][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1780910851299{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}"]Every casing connection is a pressure seal. It has to transfer load, resist fatigue, and hold up to the conditions of the wellbore for the life of the well. That performance depends on clean, undamaged threads that mate the way the manufacturer designed them to. Debris, corrosion, storage damage, or leftover thread compound can compromise make-up. On the rig floor, under time pressure, these problems are easy to miss. The result is wasted connections, rework, or worse: integrity issues that surface after the casing is cemented. Thread cleaning and inspection removes that variable. It gives the crew a known starting point and gives the operator documented evidence that the program started with sound pipe.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_message message_box_style="solid-icon" style="square" message_box_color="alert-info" icon_fontawesome="fa fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation" css=".vc_custom_1780910869638{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 48px !important;padding-right: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 48px !important;padding-left: 5em !important;background-color: #FFFFFF !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}" el_class="pull-quote info-highlight"]

“The small step that protects the rest of the program. Done in daylight before the run, not after the cement has set.”

[/vc_message][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Connected services" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779520807388{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][vc_column_text css=""]Thread services are step one in the casing program. These are the services that follow[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="25"][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1779434048501{border-top-width: 2px !important;border-right-width: 2px !important;border-bottom-width: 2px !important;border-left-width: 2px !important;padding-top: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;border-left-style: solid !important;border-right-style: solid !important;border-top-style: solid !important;border-bottom-style: solid !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_single_image image="1738" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1780986828697{margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;}"]
Casing Running and Power Tong Services
Where the prepared pipe goes next. Skilled crews and calibrated tongs running the program. Explore Casing Running[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1779433773659{border-top-width: 2px !important;border-right-width: 2px !important;border-bottom-width: 2px !important;border-left-width: 2px !important;padding-top: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;border-left-style: solid !important;border-right-style: solid !important;border-top-style: solid !important;border-bottom-style: solid !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_single_image image="1746" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false" el_class="img-greyscale"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1780986849955{margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;}"]

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

Drift results are logged per joint, with anomalies flagged and rejected pipe identified before mobilization.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

Verified pipe is released for the run. The operator has confirmed, documented evidence that the casing string meets dimensional requirements.

For operators running tight-tolerance casing programs, this is the dimensional confidence the rest of the program depends on. Initial inspection of the top drive system and confirmation of calibration baseline. Connection profiles and program-specific torque targets locked in.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
2Calibration Verification
Independent verification of top drive torque output against traceable standards. Calibration documented for the operator’s records.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
3Live Make-Up Monitoring
Real-time monitoring during operations. Every connection captured. Drift, anomalies, or out-of-spec readings flagged immediately.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Why this matters" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779521003852{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="20"][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1780916394912{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}"]Top drives drift. Define the verification scope with the operator. Confirm equipment, operating ranges, and any operator-specific accuracy targets.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
2Independent Reference Setup
Independent reference standards installed and calibrated to traceable benchmarks. The rig reading is checked against the truth.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
3Verification
Verification across the operating range. Hook load, top drive torque, and weight indicator data captured and compared. Discrepancies documented.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
4Reporting
Full verification report delivered. The operator knows what the rig is reading accurately and where corrections are needed.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Why this matters" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779521003852{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="20"][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1780917470931{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}"]A drilling rig is a complex machine reporting dozens of measurements every second. The decisions made off those numbers determine the entire program. Hook load drives weight-on-bit. Top drive torque drives connection integrity. Weight indicators drive trip safety. If those readings are wrong, every downstream decision compounds the error. Independent verification is the only way to know for sure. It is also the only way to satisfy operator audits, performance benchmarking, and AFE justification with documented confidence.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_message message_box_style="solid-icon" style="square" message_box_color="alert-info" icon_fontawesome="fa fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation" css=".vc_custom_1780917489862{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 48px !important;padding-right: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 48px !important;padding-left: 5em !important;background-color: #FFFFFF !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}" el_class="pull-quote info-highlight"]

“You cannot manage what you cannot measure. You cannot measure what you cannot verify.”

And when they drift, the connections they make up start drifting with them. ProTorque’s iron roughneck torque testing service confirms that the equipment is making up connections to spec. Independent verification, calibrated test fixtures, and documented results across the operating range.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner Iron roughneck inspected. Manufacturer spec confirmed. Test scope and torque ranges defined with the operator.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
2Test Fixture Setup
Independent test fixture installed. Calibrated reference standards verified against traceable benchmarks.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
3Torque Testing
Make-up and break-out testing across the equipment’s operating range. Readings captured and compared against reference. Drift or out-of-spec performance flagged.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
4Documentation
Test report delivered. Operator has confirmation of accuracy or documented findings for service and recalibration.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Why this matters" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779521003852{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="20"][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1780918773204{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}"]A drifting iron roughneck makes up connections that look fine on the floor but are not. Operators do not see the problem until pressure testing, until pulling pipe, or until something goes wrong downhole. By then, the cost is real. Periodic torque testing on iron roughneck systems is the standard discipline that prevents the slow, invisible drift that costs operators time and money. ProTorque provides the discipline.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_message message_box_style="solid-icon" style="square" message_box_color="alert-info" icon_fontawesome="fa fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation" css=".vc_custom_1780918790023{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 48px !important;padding-right: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 48px !important;padding-left: 5em !important;background-color: #FFFFFF !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}" el_class="pull-quote info-highlight"]

Our services
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Building midstream infrastructure that operators can count on." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780922066305{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]Midstream construction is not a single trade. It is the coordinated execution of welding, civil, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, and specialty piping work, all delivered on time and to spec. ProTorque brings the full trade capability under one roof and the field discipline to keep projects moving. New facilities. Plant expansions. Pipeline construction. Tank batteries. Saltwater disposal (SWD) builds. Specialty piping installations. ProTorque construction crews work across the Permian Basin and West Texas for operators that need a contractor who can build the whole thing without managing five different subs to do it.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" el_class="pt-tcrw-media"][dt_fancy_image image_id="1532" width="" caption="off" extra_class="img-greyscale"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="35"][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784183580051{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]

How we work
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Our process" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784184033094{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="10"][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

1

Project Scoping

Pre-job scoping with the operator or EPC. Materials, trades, timeline, site access, permitting, and specialty considerations locked in before mobilization. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

2

Mobilization

Crews, equipment, materials, and supporting trades coordinated for site arrival. Welders, electricians, mechanical, and civil crews ready before the first day of work.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

3

Execution

Construction executed to spec and schedule. Welds inspected. Civil work documented. Trades coordinated by ProTorque project leadership instead of by the operator.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]

4

Commissioning & Handoff

Final inspections, commissioning, as-built documentation, and turnover. The operator takes possession of a built facility with the records to prove it.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" equal_height="yes" content_placement="middle" bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" css=".vc_custom_1784186145197{border-bottom-width: 2px !important;border-bottom-style: solid !important;border-color: #DADADA !important;}" el_class="stretched-row" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF"][vc_column width="7/12" el_class="stretched-row-left"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_custom_heading text="Why this matters" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1784184560598{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1784611703007{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}"]Midstream construction projects fail in the gaps between trades. Welders waiting on civil. Electrical waiting on welders. Operators stuck managing subcontractors instead of running their business. ProTorque’s full-trade capability removes the gaps. One contractor. Coordinated execution. Built to spec and built to schedule. For operators expanding facility capacity, running new pipelines, or building tank batteries and SWDs, ProTorque is the construction partner that turns a project plan into a working facility.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_empty_space height="72px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" el_class="gradient-row-red" css=".vc_custom_1784060909726{padding-right: 110px !important;padding-left: 110px !important;}"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white"]

"

 

Midstream construction projects fail in the gaps between trades. ProTorque removes the gaps.

Every hour of unplanned downtime is revenue gone, throughput missed, and operators answering questions they would rather not be answering. ProTorque’s plant and pipeline maintenance services keep facilities operational, respond fast when problems show up, and execute turnarounds with the discipline midstream programs require. Ongoing maintenance. T&M work. Plant turnarounds. Pipeline integrity work. Tank battery upkeep. SWD maintenance. The work that keeps midstream operations in service, day in and day out, across the Permian and West Texas.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-steps"][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
1Scope Definition
Maintenance scope agreed with the operator. Ongoing program, T&M response, or scheduled turnaround. Crew, equipment, and timeline planned around the operator’s priorities.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
2Mobilization
Crews mobilized fast. For ongoing programs, ProTorque maintains crew availability for rapid response. For turnarounds, full project teams arrive on schedule.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
3Execution
Maintenance work executed to spec. Coordination with operator field representatives. Documentation captured throughout for permitting, audits, and ongoing facility records.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
4Reporting
Work records, inspection results, and any anomaly notes delivered to the operator. The facility is back in service with the documentation to support compliance and reliability tracking.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Why this matters" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779521003852{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="20"][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1786233841350{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}"]Downtime is the most expensive line item in any midstream operation. A scheduled turnaround that runs long, a T&M repair that takes too many days, an emergency call that goes to a crew that is not ready: all of these add up. ProTorque’s maintenance discipline keeps facilities running and minimizes the time they are not. For operators in the Permian and West Texas running active facilities and pipeline assets, ProTorque is the maintenance partner that shows up ready, executes to spec, and leaves the operator with the documentation to prove it.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_message message_box_style="solid-icon" style="square" message_box_color="alert-info" icon_fontawesome="fa fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation" css=".vc_custom_1780923076963{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 48px !important;padding-right: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 48px !important;padding-left: 5em !important;background-color: #FFFFFF !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}" el_class="pull-quote info-highlight"]

“Downtime is the most expensive line item. ProTorque’s job is to keep it from happening.”

1Scope and Estimation
Combined E&I and mechanical scope developed with the operator or EPC. Master electrician sign-off on electrical work. Mechanical lead sign-off on mechanical scope. Single project plan.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
2Trade Coordination
Internal coordination between electrical, instrumentation, and mechanical crews. Sequencing planned to avoid trade conflicts and minimize site days.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
3Execution
Combined trade crews execute on site. Electrical, instrumentation, and mechanical work delivered in parallel or sequenced as the build requires. Single point of accountability throughout.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
4Commissioning
Full commissioning including electrical testing, instrumentation verification, and mechanical functional testing. Documentation delivered. Facility ready for service.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Why this matters" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779521003852{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="20"][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1780923639821{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}"]When facility construction or maintenance requires multiple trades, the question every operator asks is: who is going to coordinate this? Subcontractors blame each other when timelines slip. Operators end up doing project management work they did not sign up for. ProTorque solves the problem by being the trades. A master electrician on staff means electrical work gets the supervision regulators expect. Mechanical trades on the same crew means sequencing happens internally, not through a status meeting between subs. Combined capability means turnkey delivery, on schedule, with one accountable contractor.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_message message_box_style="solid-icon" style="square" message_box_color="alert-info" icon_fontawesome="fa fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation" css=".vc_custom_1780923653347{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 48px !important;padding-right: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 48px !important;padding-left: 5em !important;background-color: #FFFFFF !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}" el_class="pull-quote info-highlight"]

Produced water has to be moved, treated, stored, and disposed of. Clean brine facilities have to be built, maintained, and supported. Environmental compliance has to be documented at every step. ProTorque provides the construction, maintenance, and operational services that keep water management programs running. ProTorque is the services contractor that supports the operators and water management companies running these programs across the Permian and West Texas. Construction, maintenance, E&I, mechanical, and environmental compliance services for the facilities that handle the water.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-steps"][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
1Scope and Compliance
Project scope developed with the water management operator or EPC. Environmental and regulatory requirements confirmed. Permitting status reviewed.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
2Mobilization
Crews, equipment, and materials mobilized to the facility site. Specialty crews coordinated for liner work, containment, or specialty piping where required.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
3Execution
Construction or maintenance work executed. Environmental controls maintained throughout. Documentation captured for regulatory reporting.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
4Documentation
Complete records delivered: construction documentation, environmental compliance, inspection reports, and any regulatory submissions required.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Why this matters" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779521003852{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="20"][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1786233739846{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}"]Water management is one of the most regulated areas of midstream operations. Operators running clean brine, produced water, and SWD facilities are accountable for environmental compliance, containment integrity, and operational uptime. ProTorque’s job is to support those operators with construction and maintenance services that meet the standard. For water management companies and integrated operators expanding water infrastructure across the Permian, ProTorque is the construction and maintenance partner that brings the trade capability and the documentation discipline these programs require.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_message message_box_style="solid-icon" style="square" message_box_color="alert-info" icon_fontawesome="fa fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation" css=".vc_custom_1780924187518{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 48px !important;padding-right: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 48px !important;padding-left: 5em !important;background-color: #FFFFFF !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}" el_class="pull-quote info-highlight"]

“Water management is a regulated business. ProTorque’s job is to keep facility construction and maintenance compliant from the start.”

[/vc_message][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#FFFFFF"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Connected services" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779520807388{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="25"][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1779434048501{border-top-width: 2px !important;border-right-width: 2px !important;border-bottom-width: 2px !important;border-left-width: 2px !important;padding-top: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;border-left-style: solid !important;border-right-style: solid !important;border-top-style: solid !important;border-bottom-style: solid !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_single_image image="1760" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false" el_class="img-greyscale"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1780987652627{margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-right: 16px !important;padding-left: 16px !important;}"]

Site work that gets the project ready.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="10/12"][vc_custom_heading text="The work that has to happen before construction starts." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1780926176683{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="9/12"][vc_column_text css=""]Midstream projects do not start when the construction crew arrives. They start when the site is cleared, the pad is built, and the access is in. ROW services are the foundational work that turns raw land into a buildable midstream site. ProTorque provides ROW clearing, civil work, new pad construction, and ongoing site maintenance across the Permian and West Texas. For pipeline projects, that means ROW clearing and access roads. For facility builds, that means pad construction, foundations, and civil concrete. For operating facilities, that means industrial weed control and ongoing site upkeep. ProTorque handles all of it.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="25"][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space 1Site Survey and Scope

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
2Mobilization
Equipment, crews, and materials mobilized to site. Specialty equipment (graders, compactors, concrete trucks) coordinated for the scope.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
3Execution
ROW cleared. Pads built. Civil concrete poured. Site prepared to spec. Documentation captured throughout for the operator’s records.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="pt-step" width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]
4Handoff
Site released to the construction crew. As-built documentation, civil records, and any specifications relevant to the construction team delivered.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="72px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F8F8F8"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_custom_heading text="Why this matters" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1779521003852{margin-bottom: 32px !important;padding-top: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner gap="20"][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1786258649825{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}"]Construction crews waiting for an unfinished pad cost more than the pad. Pipeline crews waiting for ROW clearing cost more than the clearing. The work that happens before construction sets the timeline for everything after. ProTorque’s ROW services are built to keep that timeline on schedule. For operators running pipeline programs, building new SWD or tank battery sites, or maintaining sites that need ongoing industrial weed control, ROW services are the foundational work that protects the rest of the project.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_message message_box_style="solid-icon" style="square" message_box_color="alert-info" icon_fontawesome="fa fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation" css=".vc_custom_1780926481547{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 48px !important;padding-right: 32px !important;padding-bottom: 48px !important;padding-left: 5em !important;background-color: #FFFFFF !important;border-color: #D5292E !important;}" el_class="pull-quote info-highlight"]

“Construction starts when the site is ready. ROW services are what get it ready.”

[vc_row bg_type="image" parallax_style="vcpb-default" bg_image_new="id^1756|url^https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/ccs-banner-1.jpg|caption^null|alt^null|title^ccs-banner|description^null" bg_image_repeat="no-repeat" bg_override="ex-full" el_class="background-image-greyscale banner-make-image-black-and-white"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][vc_custom_heading text="Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) Casing Operations" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left|color:%23FFFFFF" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1781027636185{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="page-header-h1-outline"][vc_empty_space height="16px"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white page-subheader-text"]Chrome casing, premium connections, and the documented discipline CCS wells demand for the long run.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width="10/12"][vc_empty_space height="24px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781028092023{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]
THE OPPORTUNITY
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="CCS is changing what casing programs demand." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1781028099339{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column][vc_column width="2/12"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row gap="25"][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]Carbon capture and storage is one of the fastest-growing applications in oil and gas. CCS wells are built to inject and contain CO2 for decades, sometimes generations. That means everything about the casing program is held to a higher standard. Materials, connections, make-up, and documentation all have to be right the first time, and the records have to hold up for the lifetime of the well. For operators investing in CCS infrastructure, the casing service provider is not a vendor decision. It is a long-term integrity decision.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="15"][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1781028385203{background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781027946286{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-white"]
Growing

CCS hub activity across Alberta and the US

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1781028391991{background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781027968061{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-white"]
Higher

integrity and material standards than conventional wells

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1781028399706{background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781027985723{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-white"]
Decades

of operational life span the casing has to support

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="957" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F6F6F6"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781028631512{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]
PROTORQUE’S ROLE
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Casing crews built for the program CCS requires." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1781028640699{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]ProTorque runs casing on CCS wells across North America. The experience covers chrome casing handling, premium connection make-up, documented torque-turn execution, and the pre-run discipline that protects every joint before it goes downhole. CCS is not a different service line for ProTorque. It is the same crews, equipment, and standards applied to a program that has zero margin for error.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781030892876{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}"]

item.content:encoded:
[vc_row bg_type="image" parallax_style="vcpb-default" bg_image_new="id^910|url^https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/trs-services-banner.jpg|caption^null|alt^null|title^trs-services-banner|description^null" bg_image_repeat="no-repeat" bg_override="ex-full" el_class="background-image-greyscale banner-make-image-black-and-white"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][vc_custom_heading text="Fiber-Optic Casing Installation" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left|color:%23FFFFFF" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1781032623818{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="page-header-h1-outline"][vc_empty_space height="16px"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white page-subheader-text"]Run casing with the data line that comes with it. Cable protected, connection protected, program protected.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width="10/12"][vc_empty_space height="24px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781028092023{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]
THE OPPORTUNITY
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Real-time well data starts at the casing string." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1781032667455{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column][vc_column width="2/12"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row gap="25"][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]Fiber-optic instrumented casing has become standard equipment for operators who need real-time monitoring of pressure, temperature, and acoustic events across the wellbore. Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) and Distributed Temperature Sensing (DTS) systems deliver insights that conventional wireline interventions cannot. The catch is that the data is only as good as the deployment. Running casing with fiber-optic cable on the outside is not a standard casing job. The cable is fragile. The make-up has to protect it. The handling has to keep it intact from the rack to total depth.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="15"][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1781028385203{background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781032709482{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-white"]
DAS / DTS

real-time acoustic and temperature monitoring

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1781028391991{background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781032729218{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-white"]
Unconv.

frac monitoring, CCS, geothermal applications

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1781028399706{background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781032744718{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-white"]
Permanent

monitoring across the life of the well

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="957" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F6F6F6"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781028631512{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]
PROTORQUE’S ROLE
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Casing crews that protect the cable as well as the connection." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1781032760378{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]ProTorque runs fiber-instrumented casing across North America. Our crews coordinate directly with fiber installation teams, manage cable protection through make-up, and verify connection integrity without compromising the data line. The difference between a good fiber-optic casing deployment and a bad one is in the details: how the cable is clamped, how the crew handles the joint, how make-up is coordinated with the fiber team. Get those right and the operator has a working monitoring system for the life of the well. Get them wrong and the cable is dead before the cement sets.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781032795620{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}"]

[vc_row bg_type="image" parallax_style="vcpb-default" bg_image_new="id^910|url^https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/trs-services-banner.jpg|caption^null|alt^null|title^trs-services-banner|description^null" bg_image_repeat="no-repeat" bg_override="ex-full" el_class="background-image-greyscale"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/6"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781030018714{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow text-white"]
SPECIALTY APPLICATION
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Remote Technology Operations Center (RTOC)" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left|color:%23FFFFFF" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1781036740024{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="page-header-h1-outline"][vc_empty_space height="16px"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white page-header-text-outline"]

Verification, run remotely. Same data quality. Fewer people in the line of fire.

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="48px"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width="10/12"][vc_empty_space height="24px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781028092023{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]
THE OPPORTUNITY
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="The next step in drilling verification is not at the rig." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1781036772077{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column][vc_column width="2/12"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row gap="25"][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]Drilling verification has historically required people on the rig floor. CATM operators, verification crews, data specialists. They stand where the equipment is, doing the work that protects the program. The next step is to move that work off the rig floor without losing any of the verification quality. Same data. Same calibration discipline. Same documentation. Just delivered from a centralized operations center instead of from a deck of plywood next to a top drive. That is what RTOC delivers. ProTorque’s Remote Technology Operations Center is being built to commercialize in the second half of 2026.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="15"][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1781028385203{background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781036816422{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-white"]
Same

verification quality

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1781028391991{background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781036829925{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-white"]
Fewer

people in the line of fire

Centralized

data and oversight

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="957" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F6F6F6"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781028631512{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]

It is the same drilling verification work ProTorque has been delivering for over twenty years, executed from a centralized operations center instead of from the rig floor. The standards are the same. The discipline is the same. The data is the same. The difference is that ProTorque verification engineers can monitor multiple rigs from a single location. Operators get the same documented results without putting another person in harm’s way on every rig site.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781036885107{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}"]

item.title: Data Center Water Drilling
item.dc:creator: s3admin1
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row bg_type="image" parallax_style="vcpb-default" bg_image_new="id^1795|url^https://protorque.s3-devsite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/real-time-drilling-data-banner.jpg|caption^null|alt^null|title^real-time-drilling-data-banner|description^null" bg_image_repeat="no-repeat" bg_override="ex-full" el_class="background-image-greyscale banner-make-image-black-and-white"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/12"][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][vc_custom_heading text="Data Center Water Drilling" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left|color:%23FFFFFF" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1781039160886{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="page-header-h1-outline"][vc_empty_space height="16px"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="7/12"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="text-white page-subheader-text"]Drilling water for the infrastructure powering tomorrow. Conventional drilling expertise applied to a new market.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="64px"][vc_empty_space height="64px" el_class="hide-on-mobile"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width="10/12"][vc_empty_space height="24px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781028092023{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]
THE OPPORTUNITY
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Data centers run on water. Someone has to drill for it." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1781039191825{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][/vc_column][vc_column width="2/12"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row gap="25"][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]Modern data centers consume staggering volumes of water for cooling. As hyperscale infrastructure expands across North America, the water supply has to expand with it. Data center developers need access to reliable, high-volume water sources, often from drilled wells, often on aggressive timelines. Drilling water wells for data center infrastructure is not the same as drilling for oil and gas. But the disciplines are remarkably similar. Calibrated equipment. Verified make-up. Independent monitoring. Documented results. ProTorque brings twenty-plus years of drilling discipline to a new market that needs exactly that discipline.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height="yes" gap="15"][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1781028385203{background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781039222351{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-white"]
Growing

data center infrastructure

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1781028391991{background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781039247708{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-white"]
High-volume

cooling water demand

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1781028399706{background-color: #D5292E !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781039262273{margin-top: -16px !important;margin-bottom: 16px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;}" el_class="text-white"]
Drilling

expertise that transfers

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="957" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" image_hovers="false"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_type="bg_color" bg_override="ex-full" bg_color_value="#F6F6F6"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][vc_empty_space height="48px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781028631512{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="eyebrow"]
PROTORQUE’S ROLE
[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="The same discipline. A different market." font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23000000" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1781039293545{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 16px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]ProTorque’s drilling expertise was built supporting oil and gas operators across Canada and the United States. The skills that protect a casing program also protect a water well. Calibrated equipment, documented operations, and a crew culture built on doing the work right the first time. For data center developers entering new geographic areas, ProTorque offers a drilling partner that brings established processes, verification discipline, and the kind of operational reliability that hyperscale infrastructure requires.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1781039302244{margin-bottom: 16px !important;}"]

item.title: ProTorque Celebrates 20 Years of Innovation and Leadership in Total Rig Solutions (TRS)
item.dc:creator: s3admin1
item.content:encoded:
Driving TRS Transformation

[CALGARY, April 2024] – ProTorque Energy, a leading provider of Total Rig Solutions (TRS) and midstream construction services, is celebrating its 20th anniversary. Since 2004, ProTorque has established a reputation for delivering cutting-edge services, prioritizing safety, and fostering a culture of innovation within the oil and gas industry. ProTorque recognizes that the oil and gas landscape is in a state of constant evolution. They embrace this change, proactively incorporating new technologies, streamlining workflows, and developing proprietary solutions to address the industry’s most pressing challenges. This adaptability has been key in their growth from a regional tubular running company into an international TRS and midstream solutions provider.

Innovation from Within

ProTorque’s commitment to innovation goes beyond adopting the latest advancements. Their in-house development team has created several game-changing tools:
  • Mobile Bucking Frame: Safe, On-Site Assembly and Disassembly. Provides a controlled, compact solution for making and breaking connections, reducing the need for transport and enhancing worksite safety.
  • BHA Frame: Brings the capabilities of a shop-based bucking unit directly to the rig site, saving time, reducing transport costs, and enhancing safety.
  • Tether Ring: Secures Casing Running Tools to the top drive, eliminating the risk of dangerous falls to the rig floor, protecting personnel and equipment.

Uncompromising Commitment to Safety

ProTorque boasts an exemplary safety record, achieved through rigorous training, open communication, and empowering their team to prioritize safety above all else. This dedication translates into a safe working environment for their employees and protects valuable assets for their clients.

The ProTorque Difference: People and Partnerships

ProTorque invests heavily in attracting and developing the industry’s top talent. Their team of skilled experts drives operational efficiency, fosters innovation, and delivers exceptional client service. ProTorque’s collaborative approach aligns their goals with those of their clients, making them true partners in the success of every project.

Looking Towards the Future

“We’re incredibly proud of our achievements over the past two decades,” says Landon McDonald, President of ProTorque Energy. “Our commitment to innovation, operational excellence, and above all, safety, positions us to continue redefining TRS and delivering unmatched value to our clients for years to come.”

About ProTorque Energy

ProTorque Energy is a leading international provider of Total Rig Solutions and midstream construction services for the oil and gas industry. With a focus on safety, technology, and their skilled team, they empower their clients to achieve their goals. For more information, contact us.
